description: Fetch the text content of a specific SEC filing. Returns the primary document (10-K, 10-Q, etc.) stripped of HTML, suitable for LLM consumption. Use edgar_recent_filings first to get the accession number.

cik.description: Filer CIK (with or without leading zeros).

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of text to return (default 20000, max 200000).

name: edgar_filing_content
